text: …　ちょっと　おれの　あいて　してみろ！

structure.jp: おれの　あいて　してみろ！

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb says you do it to see how it goes; みろ is its blunt order form. してみろ = 'try doing it!'.

patterns.name: 〜のあいてをする
patterns.span: おれの　あいて　してみろ
patterns.explanation: Someone's あいてをする means being their partner or opponent; the を is dropped in casual speech. おれの　あいて　してみろ = 'try being my opponent'.
